_meta.model_output_layout: [cx, cy, w, h, cls0_prob, cls1_prob] per anchor; classes already sigmoid'd; bboxes in MODEL-input pixel coords
_meta.wire_cls_mapping: Model outputs cls 0 = silver, cls 1 = black. Teensy K230ObjectType has K230_BLACK = 0, K230_SILVER = 1. The K230 script swaps before sending: wire_cls = 1 - model_cls.
_meta.notes: FLOAT32 YOLOv8 kmodel. Higher PC accuracy than v_float32 (can3 float). Trained locally on my_dataset (788 train + 139 val). Use the new anchor-free det_live_xy_yolov8.py on the K230D.
